import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { IconProvider, defaultIcons, useIcons, type IconComponent } from "@/src/lib/icon-context";
import { Toast } from "@/src/components/ui/toast";
import { FileManager } from "@/src/components/blocks/file-manager-01";

const aliases = {
  "doc-app-shell": "browser",
  "doc-data-grid": "grid",
  "doc-data-table": "table",
  "doc-info-item": "info",
  "doc-page-layout": "layout-columns",
  "doc-semantic-tokens": "chip",
  "doc-stepper": "workflow",
  "doc-surfaces": "layers",
};

const phase = process.argv[2];
const migrated = phase !== "legacy";
const oldOverrides = {
  "doc-info-item": () => <svg data-override="old-info" />,
  "doc-data-grid": () => <svg data-override="old-grid" />,
  "doc-page-layout": () => <svg data-override="old-columns" />,
};
const newOverrides = {
  ...oldOverrides,
  info: () => <svg data-override="new-info" />,
  grid: () => <svg data-override="new-grid" />,
  "layout-columns": () => <svg data-override="new-columns" />,
};

function SlotProbe() {
  const icons: Record<string, IconComponent> = useIcons();
  const defaults: Record<string, IconComponent> = defaultIcons;
  return Object.entries(aliases).map(([legacy, current]) => {
    const Icon = icons[legacy];
    assert.equal(typeof Icon, "function", legacy);
    if (migrated) {
      assert.equal(defaults[legacy], defaults[current], legacy);
      assert.equal(Icon, icons[current], legacy);
    }
    return <Icon key={legacy} />;
  });
}

function verifyOverrides(overrides: typeof oldOverrides, expected: string) {
  const html = renderToStaticMarkup(<IconProvider icons={overrides}>
    <SlotProbe />
    <section id="toast"><ul><Toast toast={{ id: "upgrade", title: "Upgrade toast", status: "info" }} /></ul></section>
    <section id="files"><FileManager items={[]} /></section>
  </IconProvider>);

  const toast = html.match(/<section id="toast">([\s\S]*?)<\/section>/)?.[1] ?? "";
  const files = html.match(/<section id="files">([\s\S]*)<\/section>/)?.[1] ?? "";
  assert.ok(toast.includes(`data-override="${expected}-info"`), phase + " Toast");
  assert.ok(files.includes(`data-override="${expected}-grid"`), phase + " File Manager grid");
  assert.ok(files.includes(`data-override="${expected}-columns"`), phase + " File Manager columns");
}

verifyOverrides(oldOverrides, "old");
if (migrated) verifyOverrides(newOverrides, "new");
console.log(`Icon upgrade render passed: ${phase}`);
